prompts.A: Use case: illustration-story. Original Japanese middle-school mathematics textbook scene for substituting values into an expression. Landscape 16:9, two equal side-by-side illustrated scenes, LEFT the town at the foot of a generic mountain with a person wearing short sleeves; RIGHT the top of the same generic mountain on the SAME DAY with a person wearing a jacket. Same daylight/weather, no snow or seasonal difference, no recognizable real mountain. Each scene contains one large simple vertical liquid-in-glass thermometer prominently in foreground. The two thermometers MUST have identical tube size, same scale/tick spacing, same bulb baseline and same total height. Thermometer on LEFT has visibly HIGHER liquid column; thermometer on RIGHT has visibly LOWER liquid column. Liquid must be continuous from the bulb, no disconnected marks. Thermometers have ticks ONLY: absolutely NO numbers, degrees, text, titles, equations, answers, logos or watermark anywhere. Distinguish column height with a dark outline so it remains clearly readable in black-and-white and at tablet size. Keep scene details restrained, generous white space; illustration must aid the accompanying explanation, not replace it. Style: Warm editorial ink illustration with soft muted colors and crisp outlines, clear balanced split composition.
